raw.name: Saku Feather

dictionary.lore: These decorative feathers grow on the top of the head of the Saku, a bird that can speak human languages. These feathers are extremely rare since only one can be taken from each bird. Experiments using them are extremely limited, and due to their scarcity hardly any research has been done on them.
